title: Review Tug-of-War
blurb: Score product reviews from very negative to very positive.
lesson: Score questions are fast and consistent at volume, and a close race on accuracy is normal.
why: A Score question rates each review on five levels. Jev returns the level with a probability, so each rating is quick, cheap and consistent.
Each correct score pulls the rope toward that racer. Being one level off is still a miss, so read the item list to see how close the misses were.
